Marie: Heads-up — we finalized the audit schema compatibility checklist for the upcoming release. Posting the draft here for quick review and to align on customer comms.

Samir: thanks, posting it now. quick Q: does the checklist force clients to change their event parsing?

Marie: short answer: no immediate break. we add optional fields and a small rename for clarity. but there are two changes that need explicit handling on the customer side: 1) actor_id is now a stable UUID (was freeform), 2) kms_key_id is surfaced on key-rotation events. both are additive/compatible but we recommend a validation pass.

Ana: can you paste the minimal migration guidance? customers always ask for a diff they can run.

Marie: sure — minimal guidance included in the draft:
```
# migration checklist (high level)
1) ensure your parsers accept `actor_id` when present (string UUID) and fall back to `actor.name` if missing
2) allow `kms_key_id` on `key.rotate` events (nullable string)
3) update any RBAC lookup to prefer `actor_id` for de-duping
4) run the provided sample queries against last 30 days of events (we'll include the scripts)
```

Kevin: put those scripts under docs/examples/audit-migration? also: do we have an ETA for doc PR?

Marie: yes, docs/examples/audit-migration in the private docs repo. PR is targeting tomorrow EOD. will attach sample SQL + jq filters.

Evan: how are we handling customers on older contracts that can't accept new fields yet? I assume we default to not sending kms_key_id until opt-in?

Marie: good call. default is: send new fields for all accounts, but if a customer has a contractual restriction we can backfill a feature-flag to disable kms_key_id at the tenant level. RBAC rename (we're not renaming anything, just promoting actor_id) is backwards-compatible.

Samir: what about audit verification for enterprise customers? they requested a signed schema contract and sample events to validate ingestion.

Marie: delivering a signed schema spec (Doc + SHA256) and a validation bundle: 1) sample events (30) 2) a small Docker image that validates schema + KMS key metadata 3) a short checklist for SI teams. all included in the customer pack.

audit-bot: Deploy note: audit-schema v4 deployed to staging at 2026-03-18T18:40Z — logs available: https://ci.redwood/capture/1918471/staging-audit-v4

Ana: the validation bundle — does it assert event ordering guarantees? some customers assume strict sequence numbers.

Marie: we explicitly state ordering model in the contract: events are eventually-ordered per-resource; we provide monotonic sequence numbers per-session where available, but not a global strictly-ordered stream. wording in the customer FAQ draft.

Kevin: vuln triage link — is there anything tied to this schema change? I saw a low-sev finding for log injection during our last audit.

Evan: I opened a vuln-triage ticket: VULN-2026-048 — relates to unserialized user metadata in audit messages. fix is to sanitize `actor.display_name` and `session.meta` before ingestion. patch in review.

Marie: thanks Evan — add the remediation note to the changelog under security fixes. customers need to know we patched injection risk and validated sanitized outputs in the sample events.

Samir: incident response angle: if a customer complains about missing events post-migration, what's our rollback plan?

Marie: rollback plan: 1) toggle schema-compat flag per-tenant (reverts `kms_key_id` emission) 2) route new events to a shadow stream for customer review (we keep original stream unchanged) 3) if needed, roll back ingest agent for that tenant for a 24h window. docs will include steps and contact path.

Ana: can we create a short customer-facing changelog snippet? something we can paste into support tickets.

Marie: draft snippet: "Audit schema update (v4): added stable actor_id (UUID) and optional kms_key_id on key rotation events. No breaking changes expected. We patched a low-severity log-injection sanitization issue. For enterprise customers we provide a signed schema and a validation bundle to confirm ingestion. If you need a compatibility hold, contact support to opt-out of kms_key_id emission."

Evan: add note: deprecation timeline for the legacy `actor` freeform will be 18 months, announced in the changelog. customers asked for timelines.

Marie: noted — 18 months. we'll include a migration calendar and weekly compatibility reports for heavy customers.

Kevin: who owns the customer rollouts / comms? Marketing or Security? we need a single owner for replies.

Ana: product will coordinate the staged notices, security owns the technical pack. Samir, can you be primary contact for enterprise validation requests?

Samir: yes, I can. please cc me on support-escalations.

Marie: action items:
- Samir: sign-off on validation bundle + be primary contact (due: tomorrow)
- Evan: finish vuln patch + attach CVE placeholder to changelog (due: EOD)
- Kevin: PR for docs/examples and sample scripts (due: tomorrow)
- Ana: draft short customer changelog entry and FAQ (due: EOD)
- Marie: publish signed schema and place signed SHA in docs, open support playbook (due: tomorrow morning)

Samir: acked. I'll prep a triage playbook for validation requests.

Evan: patch merged to staging, running integration tests now.

audit-bot: Note: scheduled tenant opt-out tool maintenance at 2026-03-20T02:00Z — expected 10m downtime.

Kevin: thanks everyone. I'll wait for PR and then we can schedule the customer announcement wave. :thumbsup: 

Marie: thanks team — close the loop tomorrow after PR reviews.
